record.direction: Both directions or unspecified in the reports
record.movement: Ordinary people, vehicles and goods; emergency patients excepted
record.exceptions: Emergency patients exempt under the reported national measure; phase is limited to ordinary Chaman traffic.
record.imposing_authority: Pakistani border authorities; contemporary reporting also attributes the closure to Kabul’s election-security decision.
record.enforcement: Contemporary report of no ordinary Chaman passage on Friday; subsequent INP report states crossings reopened after the two-day government restriction.
record.record_type: Crossing-specific episode or qualified restriction observations
record.relationship: No matching episode in the 754-parent compact inventory or screened pending additions. Shared national measures are not duplicated by post.
record.status_observation: Historical scoped evidence only; no openness or closure is inferred after the supported observations.
record.current_corrections: 2 calendar-day difference for ordinary Chaman traffic from Friday 27 September to the reported reopening on 29 September 2019. The government window was September 27–28 for Afghan election security, with emergency patients exempt. The endpoint report covers all bilateral crossings; the phase uses Chaman’s specifically reported actual onset. This is not a measured 48-hour claim.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained
record.rationale_phase_note: The government restriction is explicitly attributed to security for Afghanistan’s presidential election. No additional political pressure or regime-change purpose is inferred.
